session_id.description: Optional active session id (defaults to the sole active session).

expand_ids.description: Frontier atom ids to expand this step (capped by traverse_max_expand_per_step).

keep_ids.description: Provisional keep atom ids (must already be considered).

include_noisy_kinds.description: When true, include tool/ledger/model atoms in local_map ring and edges. Default false: sequential bridges only for noisy kinds.
